components.name: DeviceInterface
components.responsibility: Receive heart-rate measurements from external monitoring devices and forward them to the monitoring service.

components.name: MonitoringService
components.responsibility: Associate measurements with patients, retrieve patient thresholds, evaluate heart-rate measurements, and detect abnormalities.

components.name: AlertService
components.responsibility: Create alerts, notify nurses, track acknowledgments, and escalate unacknowledged alerts.

components.name: PatientRepository
components.responsibility: Store and retrieve patient monitoring information, assigned nurses, and heart-rate thresholds.

components.name: EventRepository
components.responsibility: Store abnormal heart-rate events and manage event and alert status information.

components.name: NurseInterface
components.responsibility: Display alerts, allow nurses to acknowledge alerts, and provide access to monitoring information and abnormal-event history.

components.name: AdministrationInterface
components.responsibility: Allow authorized users to register patients, assign nurses, and configure heart-rate thresholds.
